description: Mediation Boards Commission - Mediation Boards Commission, Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointments of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of judicial/legal officers (mediators) to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial positions (Chairman and Mediators) under the Mediation Boards Act, specifying eligibility criteria and appointment procedures for these quasi-judicial roles.
